The current phase freezes only local interaction inputs, outputs, and ownership.
Persistence is explicitly outside PCN planning closure and remains separately governed.
Traversal and activation mechanics may vary while Context, resource, temporal, uncertainty, and provenance constraints remain fixed.

Emotion remains a future independently owned projection and is not implemented here.
Future engineering may map governed budgets to scope without freezing global object counts.
Structural Change Candidate already requires later source-owner, Experience, and governance review.

classification_rule: Any unresolved issue that changes Owner, Object Model, Core Boundary, or Source Mutation authority must be classified BLOCKER.
